text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
First place goes to Mejiro McQueen! What 
an astonishing time! 
The Mejiro family's shining star is 
blazing fast at the crawl, toooo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
S-Swimming the whole way without coming up 
for air...! 
Haaaah~~, what incredible lung capacity!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I managed to achieve a result 
worthy of the Mejiro name. 
More importantly... it seems that person 
you admire so much is quite strong as 
well.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Next up is Block 2. Maruzensky starts off 
swimming breaststroke all on her own! 
But she's fast! Way too fast! She's 
completely run away with the race, leaving 
everyone in the dust—!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Vroom vroom! 
Nothing beats the pool in the middle of 
summer—it feels so amazingly good~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I came in 5th place... 
But the battle is just getting started! I 
promise I'll catch up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haaah—! Hup, haaah!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyah! Whoa-whoa! Not yet—!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
We're nearing the climax of the Floating 
Island Race! The lead pack is showing off 
some incredible balance! 
Oh! One just took a tumble! Can they make 
a comeback from here—?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa! Just a little further...! 
I'll take 1st place just like—kyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That's my chance! Excuse me, coming 
through!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Tightrope walking really 
gets the blood pumping, doesn't it? 
And if you get the answer wrong, the rope 
shakes and you take a plunge to the bottom 
of the pool...!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Question 2! Horse mackerels are fish. 
Dolphins are mammals. 
Now, "Seahorses are fish." True or False?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
True! Those guys told me they were fish 
back in the day! 
I had five or six of 'em in my elementary 
school class!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't you have a better bluff than that? 
I'm not falling for it...!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
The correct answer is... "True"! 
Can Nakayama Festa endure this shaking—?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Gah! What the heeell—?!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Now for our final event: The True 3000m 
Freestyle (Item Use Allowed)! 
In this race, absolutely anything goes! 
The best tools go to whoever grabs them 
first!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
What's more! Any safe interference 
permitted by the rules is totally OK! 
Like it or not, this is the final 
showdown! On your marks...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay♪ I'm gonna blast off in the pool 
too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa! I'll make up for lost ground 
right here! 
"Learn how to breathe from the flying 
fish!" *Inhaaale*—*exhaaale*~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Splashing around with plenty of spirit, 
aren't we? 
Now then, when should I overtake you...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ohohohoho! Surfer Golshi-chan has arrived, 
dahling~~~~! 
Take this, and that, and that~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Pfft-wah! Please do not splash water on 
me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Good grief, she always does whatever she 
pleases. 
Even during fun events, one ought to 
exercise some restraint...)

And with that, the qualifiers came to an 
end. Only the top 8 advance to the 
finals... 
How did Mejiro McQueen and the other four 
fare—?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, to celebrate everyone making it 
to the finals♪

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Cheeeeeeers!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Phaaah! Nothing beats Hachimii after 
working up a sweat playing around!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
After fooling around that much, I can 
hardly believe you managed to qualify as 
well... 
You barely even swam in the 200m Freestyle 
and ended up in dead last, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, swimming normally is boring! 
What's the big deal? Just gotta do 
whatever you feel like doing!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And winning anyway is just her usual 
absurd devil's luck. 
Still, I'm not handing over the 
championship to anyone, got it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, big talk! Nakayama! 
Well, lookin' forward to facing you in the 
finals too♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! We can wear whatever swimsuit 
we want in the finals, right?! This year's 
trend is 
elegant free-diver chic! Let's all go buy 
diving masks together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I will not! ...Honestly, you. 
Please make sure you do not get overly 
carried away and cause trouble for others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I too must... As a Mejiro horse girl, I 
must ensure I do not let myself get 
carried away...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah... 
Still fussing over that, are you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You're so strong in the pool too, 
Maruzen-san! 
You dominated every single event—it was so 
amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, thank you, Chiyo-chan. 
...Let's all have fun in the finals, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's enjoy it to the absolute 
fullest!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Alright! That's it for today's 
independent practice! 
Fufu, I think my accuracy has improved 
quite a bit, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(In the finals, all eight of us will 
scatter across the island, hiding and 
sneaking around 
while aiming water guns at each other in a 
serious showdown...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(I realized it clearly during the 
qualifiers. When it comes to raw physical 
ability, I can't beat those geniuses. 
But if I hone my technique, I can win...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I wonder if there are records from 
previous Splash Rec events? 
I'll go ask in the teachers' room later!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~n♪ 
I managed to get copies of all the 
previous finals videos!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe, I should probably start with the 
year Maruzen-san was in it, right? Hit 
play... and!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"It must've been a fierce battle... I 
wonder how Maruzen-san took the 
championship?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"......! Whaaat, what is this?! No 
way...!"
